provenance_and_custody_finding.upstream_c1: AnalyticalCompositionResult.composed_result_identity_hash does carry full ancestry, authority and provenance material
provenance_and_custody_finding.gap: that C1 identity is NOT reachable from, nor bound into, the F8 serving ingress. The handoff edge is the `evidence` argument, which is caller-supplied and carries its own independent, unbound provenance_refs and authority_refs.
provenance_and_custody_finding.consequence: C1 provenance and F8 provenance are two disconnected custody chains. A caller can present F8 evidence whose authority/provenance has no relationship to the C1 composition that allegedly produced it.
provenance_and_custody_finding.custody_owner_for_f8_evidence: NONE. PossibilitySliceEvidence is a frozen dataclass constructed directly by whoever calls the ingress; there is no minting owner, no sealed registry and no unforgeable producer identity.
provenance_and_custody_finding.independently_administered_principal: ABSENT. Nothing at runtime distinguishes an owner-originated slice from a caller-constructed one.

honest_negative_claim.what_is_proven: G1 substitution is real, reproduces at runtime, and is invisible to F8 evaluation and to the replay verifier.
honest_negative_claim.what_is_NOT_proven: that any in-process control can authenticate producer origin; that source-free origin proves an externally administered principal; that any F7/AT07/native path participates here (explicitly out of scope and not touched).
